subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently own this generated Microsoft tracker and live PR-body updater as repository automation, or keep the tracking workflow confined to a draft PR body?
rationale: The patch creates a durable, mutable triage source of truth whose maintenance and release-policy costs cannot be resolved from implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Keep Draft Tracker
options.body: Continue using the PR body as the living Microsoft tracker without merging the generator or generated repository artifact.

options.title: Sponsor Repository Generator
options.body: Confirm repository ownership, then require the correctness fixes, verification mode, focused coverage, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Retire The Tracker
options.body: Close the draft if GitHub search, labels, projects, and normal issue ownership are sufficient and no maintainer will own refreshes.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft Tracker
recommendation.body: Continue using the PR body as the living Microsoft tracker without merging the generator or generated repository artifact.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets repository-wide maintainer workflow and release-policy direction rather than only deciding a local script repair.
